text: At 29 minutes, Ironvale Athletic nearly added to their lead when Oskar Lindgren fired a close-range shot that was saved, missing a chance worth about 4 in 10 to score [#545]. The attack began deep in their own half with a strong tackle by Jonah Lindqvist who then linked passes with teammates before threading a perfect through ball to Lindgren behind Redmond Rovers’ high defense [#535] [#541]. Ironvale’s quick, direct counterplay is causing problems, especially since Redmond Rovers press high but leave space at the back.
